title: useClamp Hook
description:
Implement a `useClamp` hook that returns `{ value, increment, decrement }`. The value is bounded between `min` and `max` — `increment` stops at `max` and `decrement` stops at `min`.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { value, increment, decrement } = useClamp(5, 0, 10);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: not using the functional updater form — writing setValue(Math.min(value + 1, max)) captures a stale closure value instead of the latest state.
